text:
Sam (Growth): Quick triage: weekly KPI shows launch-post CTR steady but paid MQLs down ~20% and webinar RSVPs from paid dipped. dropping here to diagnose before Friday send. :eyes:
Ivy (Analytics): looking. initial signal: an uptick in conversions with missing utm_campaign and a bounce spike for clicks routed through redirector.edgeproxy.io around 10:15 PT.
Rosa (MarOps): I touched campaign canonicalization this sprint but only for affiliates. paid tags shouldn't be affected.
Cal (Product Marketing): only an organic headline microtest yesterday; paid creative asset IDs unchanged per registry.
Ivy (Analytics): quick query I ran to inspect campaign buckets:
```
SELECT COALESCE(utm_campaign,'(missing)') campaign, COUNT(*) convs
FROM conversions
WHERE created_at >= '2026-10-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY convs DESC
LIMIT 8;
```
Ivy (Analytics): result shows a spike in (missing) tied to referer host edgeproxy.io. vendor status notes a redirect shim test this morning.
Rosa (MarOps): that matches open ticket EP-707. I'll escalate and ask for a rollback on the test traffic.
Sam (Growth): For Friday KPI email we need defensible numbers. Can BI add a pragmatic fallback attribution column (heuristic) so we don't undercount paid for the send?
Ivy (Analytics): I can add heuristic_campaign to the ETL: prefer utm_campaign -> session last-non-null campaign -> referer-domain mapping. low risk. ETA ~30m to BI.
dash-bot: dashboard "launch_kpis_weekly" updated by Ivy. https://bi.redwood/d/launch_kpis_weekly
Cal (Product Marketing): long-term let's capture a hidden server-side campaign token on registration so client-side utm loss won't break attribution. low lift.
Rosa (MarOps): adding hidden_campaign_server to backlog and updating EP-707. will post vendor response.
Sam (Growth): owners: Rosa -> vendor follow-up + backlog; Ivy -> ETL heuristic + dashboard patch; Cal -> confirm creative registry; Sam -> re-run WoW and finalize Friday KPI note.
Ivy (Analytics): will post raw vs heuristic numbers when ETL finishes so leadership can see the delta.
Sam (Growth): thanks team :thumbsup: will add a one-liner in the KPI email: "Attribution cleanup in progress; numbers may adjust."
